items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I said, “Harris, get my bass clarinet man.”

ctx.x: So you had a lot of horns.

I had a lot of horns and I was a collector. I’ve been collecting horns since I had the C melody that I started on. I had that. So I had about three or four C melodies, I had all kinds of altos, I bought a straight alto. I was probably one of the first people in the United States, not from the twenties, they made one from the twenties, I sold that one, I got one of them. But I bought one in Amsterdam that was more in tune than that old one I had. But in fact I’ve still got a straight, but I had a couple basses,…
make him think. I said, “look I may walk down on a gig one night and just say, ‘give it to me.’” I will just get mad and keep it.
